Assert that spells do not overlap within a unit

Source: R/ensure_no_overlap.R
ensure_no_overlap.Rd

A checkpoint for spell data, the other common shape of register data: address periods, employment spells, benefit periods. Each unit can only be in one spell at a time, so two spells for the same person that share a day are an error. Returns data, so it can sit in the middle of a pipeline.

Usage

ensure_no_overlap(
  data,
  id,
  start,
  end,
  success_msg = NULL,
  warn_msg = NULL,
  abort_msg = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame or tibble, a database table (dbplyr, e.g. DuckDB) or an Arrow table or dataset; see Database and Arrow tables.

id

Column(s) identifying the unit (tidy-select), e.g. cpr.

start, end

Columns with the first and last period of each spell (dates, or integers such as years).

success_msg

Message shown when the rule holds. If NULL (default), it is "Check passed: <message>" when warn_msg or abort_msg is given, so the console names every check that ran, and a description of the check otherwise.

warn_msg

Message shown when spells overlap and no abort_msg is set. Defaults to a description of the check.

abort_msg

If provided, cli::cli_abort() is called with this message when the rule is broken. If NULL (default), a warning is issued instead.

Value

data invisibly, unchanged.

Details

On failure the overlapping spells are reported with an overlap_id column prepended, in the spirit of dupid in ensure_unique(): spells that overlap each other (directly or through a chain) share an id, so each conflict can be inspected as a group.

Spells are treated as closed intervals, as register dates usually are: a spell ending 31 January and one starting 1 February do not overlap, while one ending and one starting on 1 February do. A missing end means an ongoing spell and overlaps everything after its start. Rows with a missing start are ignored. Check missing starts and ends before starts with ensure_valid_spells() before checking overlaps.

See also

describe_spells() to see how spells relate first, merge_spells() when overlapping spells are one spell recorded twice, ensure_balanced() for yearly panels, checkpoints.

Examples

addresses <- data.frame(
  cpr   = c("a", "a", "b", "b"),
  start = as.Date(c("2020-01-01", "2021-01-01", "2020-01-01", "2020-06-01")),
  end   = as.Date(c("2020-12-31", NA,           "2020-06-30", "2021-12-31"))
)

# b has two addresses in June 2020
ensure_no_overlap(addresses, cpr, start, end)
#> Warning: Overlapping spells per cpr
#> ℹ 2 rows in 1 group:
#>     overlap_id cpr   start      end
#>          <int> <chr> <date>     <date>
#>   1          1 b     2020-01-01 2020-06-30
#>   2          1 b     2020-06-01 2021-12-31
